name: Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope
description: The first Star Wars movie, chronologically the fourth in the franchise, is released.

name: Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back
description: The second Star Wars movie is released, continuing the original trilogy.

name: Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi
description: The third and final movie of the original trilogy is released.

name: Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace
description: The first movie of the prequel trilogy is released, revealing the early years of the Star Wars universe.

name: Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones
description: The second movie of the prequel trilogy is released, continuing the story of the Clone Wars.

name: Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith
description: The third and final movie of the prequel trilogy is released, revealing the fall of Anakin Skywalker and the rise of Darth Vader.

name: Star Wars: The Clone Wars
description: The animated movie and subsequent TV series expand on the events of the Clone Wars, filling in the gap between Episode II and III.

name: Star Wars Episode VII: The Force Awakens
description: The first movie of the sequel trilogy is released, introducing new characters and continuing the Star Wars saga.

name: Star Wars Episode VIII: The Last Jedi
description: The second movie of the sequel trilogy is released, further exploring the conflict between the Resistance and the First Order.

name: Star Wars Episode IX: The Rise of Skywalker
description: The final movie of the Skywalker saga is released, concluding the epic story of Star Wars.
